This could potentially undermine the separation between the courts and the government, according to Kaul.

title: BJP calls for nationwide protest over Kharge’s ‘baap’ remark
content: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge's comment about Prime Minister Narendra Modi's father sparked widespread outrage among BJP members. Following the incident, the BJP announced nationwide protests against Kharge's remarks, labeling them indecent and offensive. Union home minister Amit Shah criticized Congress for personal attacks and blamed it on their electoral disappointments. Kharge also condemned the ongoing Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, describing it as a threat to democracy.

title: Nasa’s Isaacman shares Artemis IV update as SpaceX, Blue Origin plan Moon base
content: NASA administrator Jared Isaacman provided an update regarding the Artemis III lunar mission and upcoming docking exercises. The agency plans for significant interactions with Elon Musk's SpaceX and Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin next year. Docking practices will involve astronaut teams launching aboard NASA's Orion capsule from Cape Canaveral. Isaacman indicated that the competition has intensified due to historical precedents set by earlier space missions.

title: Alabama lawyer quit practice to care for parents; court voids her condo deed
content: The Alabama Supreme Court has affirmed a lower court's ruling that invalidated a property transfer from parents to their daughter, Holly Schumpert. Despite her dedication in caring for her ailing parents, the court determined the coastal condominium was part of a family trust, rendering the deed null. As a result, laws designed to protect elderly property owners allowed the reversal, leading to Holly having no claim to the estate.

title: 80-ton boulder at NH Polar Caves since 1922 collapses, no injuries
content: In a surprising turn of events on October 18, 2026, an 80-ton granite boulder collapsed at Polar Caves Park in Rumney, New Hampshire, smashing a wooden walkway and its safety rails. Fortunately, this incident resulted in no injuries. The boulder's fall is likely due to weather-related erosion. Park authorities are now assessing the situation and implementing repair plans to allow for a safe return of visitors in spring 2027.

title: Husband jailed next door missed hearing, lost home; court reopens case
content: A Kansas appeals court recently vacated a previous ruling in a divorce property case, asserting that Scott L. Hale was not given a fair chance to participate. Haltingly unable to attend his hearing due to incarceration, Scott's objections to the property division were overlooked by the trial judge. The court's decision sends the matter back to the lower court for a comprehensive reassessment and new hearing.

title: Rocket founder Dan Gilbert forgoes profits on $2.2 billion Detroit redevelopment
content: Dan Gilbert has pledged a remarkable $1 billion towards the revitalization of the Renaissance Center and Detroit's east riverfront. By establishing a nonprofit, this investment is transformed into a philanthropic donation, prioritizing community well-being over profit. After covering initial costs, future revenues will support local initiatives and foster public spaces, aiming to breathe new life into the aging infrastructure while enriching the community's cultural landscape.

title: Woman dreamt collector, built trust aiding goldsmiths, students, trans housing
content: M Padmavathi founded the Community Renovation and Organisation Advancement Trust to promote economic empowerment in her community. This organization aids goldsmiths, underprivileged children, and transgender individuals in securing financial stability. Between 2015 and 2020, around 4,200 students benefited from after-school coaching programs, while initiatives also aimed at connecting transgender individuals with government resources and employment opportunities. Her dedication illustrates a profound commitment to uplift lives and nurture self-sufficiency.

title: Patrick Mahomes' Alpine F1 investment surges as team value hits $2.6 billion
content: Patrick Mahomes’ investment in Alpine F1 is drawing attention as the team’s estimated valuation rises from $900 million in 2023 to $2.6 billion in 2026, an increase of nearly 189%. Mahomes joined the investor group alongside Travis Kelce and other high-profile names through Otro Capital. Alpine’s rising value reflects Formula 1’s growing commercial appeal. However, Mahomes’ individual investment amount and ownership stake have not been publicly disclosed.

title: Travis Kelce's $5.35 million estate faces opposition over landscaping plans
content: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion faces fresh delays as neighbors challenge his landscaping and fencing plans. Residents have raised concerns about wildlife safety, lake views and potential damage to an aging sewer line, with one neighbor citing $75,000 in repair costs. Kelce’s construction team says it has spent $7,500 on sewer repairs and adjusted the plans. However, local officials require further changes before the remaining landscaping work can proceed.

title: EC refuses to give details of SIR software, cites ‘trade secrets, IPR'
content: Election Commission of India declined to share the name of the software used for identifying electoral roll errors. The request for information was made under the Right to Information Act. A social activist from Telangana sought details about the software and algorithms used in the process. The Commission stated that no new software was developed for the exercise conducted.

title: Banks pass on rate hikes, but go slow when rates fall; RBI study finds
content: A recent study by the RBI indicates that banks are more responsive to interest rate hikes than to cuts. Specifically, banks relayed 76.4% of repo rate increases, while only 64% of reductions were passed on. Amid periods of tightening, lending rates surged significantly, in contrast to the minimal decreases observed during easing. This research highlights the intricate dynamics of interest rate adjustments, particularly affecting sectors like MSMEs.

title: EPFO considers Rs 25,000cr war chest to stabilise interest payouts
content: Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation is exploring the establishment of a Rs 25,000-crore Interest Stabilisation Reserve. This reserve aims to protect members’ interest payouts from corporate bond defaults and other market fluctuations. A report suggested that the fund should be built via surplus ETF gains and will invest in government securities. Historical performance indicates that this reserve can effectively manage interest rate stability.

title: Trump gears up for Iran escalation after US polls; Tehran says position unchanged
content: US President Donald Trump has signaled potential military action against Iran following the upcoming midterm elections. The US has increased its military presence in the Persian Gulf with additional aircraft and troops. Iran is reportedly preparing for retaliation against US and allied interests in the region. Both Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu may view renewed conflict as a political strategy.

title: ‘Grabbed hair, tore shirt’: Patient attacks doctor, hospital staff in Punjab
content: Rajatpal Singh, a patient at a Kharar hospital, allegedly assaulted a medical officer and damaged property. The violent incident occurred during treatment when Singh attacked the doctor and a nurse. Hospital staff intervened and subdued Singh before police intervention. Following the incident, the Punjab Civil Medical Services Association called for improved security measures. A deadline was set for November 12 to enhance safety at sub-divisional hospitals in Punjab.

title: Biosimilar drugs breaking high-cost barrier to cancer immunotherapy
content: Recent changes in cancer care in India show an increase in immunotherapy prescriptions due to affordable biosimilars. Doctors report that the availability of cheaper versions of nivolumab has improved patient access to treatment. Research indicates that lower doses may be effective for Indian patients, contributing to the affordability of therapy. Although progress has been made, significant challenges remain regarding drug availability and hospital practices.

title: Jamia protest: FIR against oppn MPs for trespassing on campus

The MPs are accused of entering the university without permission amid ongoing demands for reinstating the students' union. Protesters are also calling for a halt to disciplinary measures against students and improved campus facilities, while university officials draft guidelines for upcoming union elections, adding to the complexity of the situation.

title: The guardians keeping watch on Kota’s kids

Community interventions such as the darwaze par dastak initiative have been established to provide timely support. Local authorities are engaging with students directly to build trust and offer help as needed. Counseling and wellness programs have been integrated to support mental health in coaching centers.

title: ‘He abused us’: Navy man’s wife, 3 children consume rat poison in Faridabad

The wife and three children consumed rat poison after the husband verbally abused them. As their condition worsened, the eldest daughter called for emergency assistance. All four family members were taken to a local hospital and later referred to a hospital in Delhi.

title: Ami Bera re-election bid: Indian-American Democrat to run in new 3rd District
content: ami Bera is seeking re-election to the US House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election . the 3rd district covers large parts of Placer, El Dorado and Nevada counties and extends into the city of Sacramento . he is the longest-serving Indian-American member of the US Congress .

title: Serbia’s Vucic concedes defeat as student-led movement wins parliamentary election
content: supporters of the electoral list celebrate after long-time leader conceded defeat in parliamentary elections to a student-backed opposition movement . crowds filled the city’s main boulevards, with smoke hanging in the air and supporters waving flares . the celebrations marked the culmination of a two-year protest movement that had called for Vucic to step down .

title: ‘Creamy layer case in SC won’t hit seniority of CSE-2025 batch’: Sources
content: official sources say the pendency of the case will not affect the seniority of successful candidates of 2025 batch . doPT officials said the department and all training institutes are prepared to allocate services expeditiously to CSE- 2025 candidates and commence foundation course at the earliest . the clarification concerns the fate of candidates in the wake of SC’s Rohith Nathan judgement of March 11 .

title: Massive fire engulfs Shiv Market near Jammu Railway Station, 35-40 shops gutted
content: around 35 to 40 shops were completely gutted after a massive fire broke out at Shiv Market . no casualties or injuries have been reported so far . the cause of the fire remains unknown . BJP MLA says the blaze began due to a short circuit in one shop .

title: CBSE makes AI a part of formal teaching, NCERT develops module
content: artificial intelligence (AI) is moving from being an optional subject towards becoming a basic skill for CBSE schoolchildren . move is part of a wider effort to make AI literacy accessible to students, irrespective of whether they study computers or choose AI as an elective .

title: US midterms 2026: Pooja Sethi’s journey from law and business to Texas politics
content: Pooja Sethi is an Indian-American Democrat running for the Texas House of Representatives from district 47 . she advanced from the Democratic primary held on March 3, 2026 . her candidacy comes amid increasingly heated debates in Texas over immigration, demographic change and national identity .

title: Give mayors real powers, ensure timely civic audits, urban body heads tell Centre
content: a mayor-in-council system is shared between the mayor and a sma . the move would serve little purpose without giving mayors adequate powers . mayors in municipal governance are like governors, while standing committees wielde financial powers and executive officials remain under the control of state govts .

title: Nuclear reactors, 90-day survival plan: How US is preparing for a global war
content: the plan aims to ensure american forces can continue fighting even if power grids fail, supply chains collapse and civilian services are disrupted during a major conflict . the u.s. defence is expanding its focus on emerging technologies and future battlefields through initiatives such as Project Meridian .

title: Raids on NE drug cartels reveal illicit deals worth Rs 270cr
content: multi-agency raids in assam, Mizoram and manipur exposed over Rs 270 crore in narco-hawala transactions . the raids led to arrest of six people and freezing of over 1,425 mule bank accounts . properties worth over Rs 26 crore were also frozen or attached during the searches .

title: Afghanistan hit by 5.5 magnitude earthquake
content:
Image credit: National Center for Seismology

An earthquake of magnitude 5.5 struck Afghanistan at 11.14 pm IST on Saturday, the National Center for Seismology said. The epicentre was located at latitude 36.157 and longitude 71.240, at a depth of 129 km. No immediate reports of damage or casualties were available.This is a developing story.
